description: This file implements a foreground service for music playback in an Android application. It manages media playback state, controls, and exposes methods for play, pause, seek, shuffle, and repeat functionalities.

classes.name: MusicPlaybackService
classes.description: An Android Service responsible for controlling music playback, maintaining playback state, and handling play/pause, seek, shuffle, and repeat functionalities.

classes.name: MusicBinder
classes.description: Binder class providing clients with access to the MusicPlaybackService instance.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the IBinder for clients binding to this service.

methods.name: playTrack
methods.description: Sets up the MediaPlayer with the selected track and starts playback.

methods.name: togglePlayPause
methods.description: Pauses or resumes playback depending on current state.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks the media to a specified position.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases MediaPlayer resources when the service is destroyed.
